title: Camp Black Lake
teaser: Every autumn, on the last night of the season, director Pierce told the story of the man with the hook around the campfire. This time the kids had already been sent home, and only the counsellors and staff were left at camp. Pierce was found in a boat by the jetty, with a rusty hook hanging on the post above him. Everyone who has worked even one summer at Black Lake knows that story by heart.

habits.label: Marshmallows in the pockets
habits.habit: Pockets stuffed with marshmallows for the campfire
clues: A white marshmallow is squashed in the boat by the boathouse jetty, and Pierce couldn't stand sweets. The culprit's pockets are stuffed with marshmallows.
The couch in the infirmary has sticky marshmallow crumbs, and marshmallows were only handed out at the campfire. The culprit carries marshmallows for the campfire in their pockets.

habits.label: KISS T-shirt
clues: On the wet tiles of the old shower block there's a scrap of black jersey with a silver lightning bolt from the KISS logo. The culprit has a KISS T-shirt.
The bread van driver saw a black T-shirt with silver KISS letters in the mess hall window. The culprit wears a KISS T-shirt.

habits.label: Glow stick
habits.habit: A glow stick on a cord round their neck
clues: A piece of glow stick lies on the boathouse jetty boards, green light still flickering inside. The culprit has a glow stick round their neck.
After one in the morning someone at the main lodge window saw a green light swaying in the dark at chest height. The culprit wears a glow stick round their neck.

habits.label: Red torch
habits.habit: A torch taped over with red cellophane
clues: A fisherman on the far bank saw a red patch of light drift across the campfire clearing after midnight. The culprit has a torch covered with red cellophane.
On the wet floor of the old shower block there's a circle of red cellophane with bits of electrical tape, exactly the size of a torch lens. The culprit shines a red torch.

habits.label: Plays with a yo-yo
clues: A red yo-yo with a snapped string lies under a bunk in the counsellors' cabin. The culprit never goes without a yo-yo.
The cook's helper heard the steady whirr of a yo-yo being spun in the dark under the mess hall window. The culprit is always spinning a yo-yo.

habits.label: Bin-bag cape
habits.habit: A cape made from a black bin bag
clues: In the infirmary a shred of black polythene with a torn edge hangs on the handle of the medicine cabinet. The culprit wears a bin-bag cape.
On a log by the campfire clearing there's a melted drop of black polythene, as if from a cape that brushed the fire. The culprit has a cape made from a black bin bag.

habits.label: Smells of bug spray
clues: Pierce's office in the main lodge smells sharply of mosquito spray, though the mosquitoes were gone by September. The culprit smells of mosquito spray.
The life jacket taken off its hook in the boathouse reeks of repellent. The culprit smells of bug spray.

habits.label: Beef jerky
clues: A greasy beef jerky wrapper was dropped on the mess hall steps. The culprit chews beef jerky.
A half-eaten strip of beef jerky, quite fresh, lies on the windowsill in the old shower block. The culprit is never without beef jerky.

habits.label: Pocket transistor
habits.habit: Never switches off their pocket transistor radio
clues: After midnight the local station's weather report was faintly audible from the old shower block, as if from a pocket radio. The culprit is never without a transistor.
A square transistor battery, quite new, lies in the grass of the campfire clearing. The culprit carries a pocket transistor.

habits.label: Patched jacket
habits.habit: A denim jacket covered in patches
clues: A rainbow patch, torn off with its blue threads, is caught on the infirmary door hinge. The culprit wears a denim jacket with patches.
The cleaner saw a back in a denim jacket covered in patches in the main lodge window. The culprit has a patched denim jacket.

habits.label: Red bandana
habits.habit: A red bandana round their neck
clues: A red thread with white paisley, like from a bandana, is caught on the rusty hook above the boat in the boathouse. The culprit wears a red bandana round their neck.
A neighbour from the farm brought firewood and saw someone by the counsellors' cabin with a red bandana pulled up over their nose. The culprit wears a red bandana.

habits.label: Plays guitar
habits.habit: Plays guitar and has the calluses to show for it
clues: Pierce's guitar by the campfire clearing was out of tune all evening, and now all six strings are perfectly tuned. The culprit plays the guitar.
A tortoiseshell pick worn down on one edge lies on the windowsill of the counsellors' cabin. The culprit can play the guitar.

habits.label: Menthol cigarettes
clues: By the wall of the old shower block there are three fresh cigarette ends with a green stripe by the filter: menthols. The culprit smokes menthol cigarettes.
Pierce's ashtray in the main lodge has a menthol stub in it, and Pierce smoked only strong unfiltered ones. The culprit smokes menthols.

habits.label: Whistle on a lanyard
habits.habit: A whistle on a braided lanyard
clues: From the far bank people heard two short whistle blasts from the boathouse, like at morning line-up. The culprit has a whistle on a lanyard.
A broken braided lanyard with a whistle ring lies on the infirmary floor. The culprit wears a whistle on a lanyard.

habits.label: Mood ring
habits.habit: A mood ring that changes colour on their finger
clues: The cleaner saw a ring at the mess hall counter whose stone turned from blue to black before her eyes. The culprit has a mood ring.
A cloudy green stone that fell out of a mood ring lies in the soap dish in the counsellors' cabin. The culprit wears a mood ring.

habits.label: Digital watch
habits.habit: A digital watch that beeps every hour
clues: A plastic strap with a buckle from a digital watch lies in the ashes of the campfire clearing. The culprit has a digital watch.
Pierce's notebook, left in the mess hall, has a note: "Someone's watch beeped again at the meeting. Find out whose." The culprit has a digital watch that beeps every hour.

keys: The boat shed at the boathouse is padlocked, yet in the night it was unlocked without force, the shackle intact. The culprit had keys.
The infirmary has been locked since the last day of the season, but tonight it was unlocked and locked again, and the lock is intact. The culprit had keys.
sched: The camp generator is shut off at exactly one in the morning, and someone came to the boathouse jetty in the first minutes of darkness. The culprit knows the schedule.
On the last night of the season Pierce always checks the boats alone after the campfire, and someone was already waiting for him at the boathouse. The culprit knows the schedule.
strong: The rusty hook is driven into the post at the boathouse so deep that it can't be pulled out even with two hands. The culprit is physically strong.
The heavy flat-bottomed boat with Pierce in it was hauled along the boathouse jetty against the wind, and it's hard work even for two. The culprit is physically strong.
quiet: The screen door of the counsellors' cabin bangs on its spring loud enough to hear along the whole shore, yet in the night it was opened and closed without a sound. The culprit moves silently.
Someone walked over the gravel under the open window of the main lodge, and nobody sitting inside even looked up. The culprit moves silently.
tools: The chain locking the boats to the boathouse jetty has been undone: one link was neatly bent open and squeezed shut again. The culprit is handy with tools.
The screen on the infirmary window was taken off and put back, every screw in place and tight. The culprit is handy with tools.
tech: The floodlight over the boathouse is out: one wire in the junction box has been neatly disconnected. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The cassette recorder at the campfire clearing was set to record over, and the last half hour of campfire talk has been erased. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
driver: In the evening the camp pickup stood by the gates, and now it's by the mess hall with a warm bonnet. The culprit can drive.
A fresh rut runs across the wet grass from the main lodge to the old shower block, though there's no road there. The culprit can drive.
cash: The last week's takings are gone from the tuck shop's iron cash box in the mess hall, yet the book balances to the cent. The culprit had access to money.
The envelope with the buyer's deposit was in Pierce's jacket at the boathouse, and three hundred is missing from it. The culprit had access to money.
safe: The safe in Pierce's office in the main lodge was opened with the combination, and the folder with the land deed is no longer there. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The incident log for the summer of 1968 is kept in the main lodge safe, and now its last page is missing, though the safe is locked on its combination again. The culprit knows the safe combination.
medic: The beer can Pierce took from the campfire clearing has a bitter sediment of crushed pills. The culprit knows about poisons.
A figure has been altered in the infirmary's medicine log, and exactly enough sleeping pills to knock out a grown man are missing from the bottle. The culprit knows about poisons.
passages: A path marked by notches on the pines leads through the bog from the counsellors' cabin to the boathouse, and tonight someone walked it in wet shoes. The culprit knows the service passages.
A crawlway under the decking leads from the old shower block to the shore. It was boarded up back in 1968, and now the boards have been pushed aside. The culprit knows the service passages.
